title: Detecting the Role of an Entity in Harmful Memes: Techniques and Their Limitations
reasoning: The paper focuses on multimodal classification to detect specific roles (hero, villain, victim) in harmful memes as part of the CONSTRAINT-2022 shared task. While the content of the memes may involve religious or ethical targets, the paper itself is a technical study of classification models (unimodal and multimodal) rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religious beliefs, faith systems, or moral/ethical reasoning frameworks.
